title: Japanese Tinga Tacos
description: A fusion twist on traditional Japanese cuisine, combining the flavors of Mexico with the boldness of Japanese seasonings.

ingredients.name: Tinga
ingredients.notes: Shredded chicken in chipotle tomato sauce

ingredients.name: Energizing tortillas
ingredients.notes: Whole wheat or whole grain tortillas

ingredients.name: Japanese seasoning blend
ingredients.notes: Combine soy sauce, sake, and mirin

instructions: 1. In a pan, heat 1 tsp of sesame oil over medium-high.
2. Add the tinga and cook for 3-4 minutes, until heated through.
3. Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
4. Assemble the tacos by spooning the tinga onto a tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of sterbottensost cheese.
5. Drizzle with Japanese seasoning blend and garnish with sesame seeds.
